name: react-portfolio
description: Personal portfolio — React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, i18next (EN/PL/UK). Built for recruiters and hiring teams.

paragraphs: Full-Stack Developer (career changer) · React · Next.js · TypeScript · Node.js
Six years on the line at large meat-processing plants → 1.5 years of intensive study (Mate Academy plus additional courses) → 8 shipped projects, including a real-time chat app and a Stripe checkout.

This repository is my personal portfolio site. It is deliberately built as a hands-on demonstration of Object-Oriented Programming and Test-Driven Development, not just a page with links: the projects, courses and skills shown on the site are modelled as TypeScript classes and covered by unit tests.
features: Hero, About me, Skills, Projects, Contacts sections with a sticky header and smooth-scroll navigation.
Featured projects first (Chat App, IvKoff Store, Expenny), then the full learning path below it.
Skills — 49 technologies in 9 categories, all defined as data and rendered from Skills / Category models.
Projects grouped by learning path — each course shows its progress and the projects built during it, including an honest "first attempt vs. finished version" story for the Chat App.
Language switcher with flags (EN / PL / UA).
